digest.component_or_area: completion verifier context assembly and caching
propositions: The completion verifier currently re-fetches 67-82% of files that are already declared in ticket file_impact, causing 84-158 redundant tool calls and runaway loops dominated by search_files repeat signatures

Adding a prefetch section to the fenced ticket_context can reduce verification request count by 20%+ (measured 30-56% on live pairs) while maintaining equal verdict class, by pre-loading declared file_impact contents and referencing-commit diffs under the existing automatic prompt cache

The prefetch must respect the close gate's graph=False boundary (own file_impact only, no subtree walk) while graph=True deep-review path uses subtree-union ranked by cross-descendant frequency, with skeleton-compression for files >500 lines and per-file/aggregate token clamping

The prefetch is opt-in via a new prefetch parameter on assemble_context (default None) so generic review callers remain byte-identical; only gate_ops.py passes a PrefetchSpec, keeping the tool surface unchanged

Recovery successors receive the prefetch via the shared assembled ticket_context as a byte-stable cache_prefix block, with prefetch bytes included in physical_context_ceiling so oversize prefetch is trimmed rather than overflowed

Anti-anchoring trust guidance must be in the static completion_verifier.md system prompt before the volatile marker (inherited by successor_system_prompt and recovery _EVIDENCE_SYSTEM), instructing the verifier to rely on full bodies directly and re-read only skeleton-marked files, never to re-confirm against the live tree
